task.prompt: The tag summary tests fail only when they run together. Diagnose the leaked state and fix the implementation without changing the tests. Run the tests when you are done.

checks.command: node --input-type=module -e "import {summarizeTags} from './src/tag-summary.js'; const first = summarizeTags(['red', 'blue']); const second = summarizeTags(['yellow', 'green']); if (first !== 'blue, red' || second !== 'green, yellow') { console.error({first, second}); process.exit(1); }"
